steps.name: CreateScaleCube
steps.label: Create Scale Cube
steps.goal: Create a Cube that represents the height of the character as pulled from the character msd on disk.
steps.pass_criteria: Cube exists in the scene called "SCALE_REF"
steps.min_scenario: You hand-build the structure to the studio's convention — when the convention is clear and the inputs are present.
steps.max_scenario: The convention is undocumented or inconsistent across artists; you rebuild and reconcile it by hand.

steps.name: ImportDesignViews
steps.label: Import Design Views
steps.goal: Import the primary design view (front ortho) from the dsn MSD as a reference image plane.
steps.pass_criteria: At minimum one view image plane is in the scene.
steps.fail_criteria: No images are brought into the scene.
steps.min_scenario: Published dsn with a front view — one lookup, one import.
steps.max_scenario: No dsn publish or missing view images; manual hunt required.

steps.name: ImportDesignGlb
steps.label: Import Design Model
steps.goal: Import the design GLB into the DSN collection as a read-only design artifact. It serves as the UV and silhouette source; it is NOT the hero mesh.
steps.pass_criteria: GLB mesh is in the scene; shared_data["dsn_mesh"] is set.
steps.fail_criteria: Import failed or no mesh found in GLB.
steps.min_scenario: Published dsn with a .glb — one lookup, one import.
steps.max_scenario: No dsn publish or missing .glb; manual mesh setup required.

steps.name: CreateProxyModel
steps.label: Create Proxy Model
steps.goal: Voxel-remesh then decimate the design GLB to produce a clean low-density proxy. This proxy becomes the hero 'hi' asset after UV transfer.
steps.pass_criteria: Decimated proxy mesh exists; shared_data["proxy_mesh"] is set.
steps.fail_criteria: No dsn_mesh in scene or voxel/decimate failed.
steps.min_scenario: Clean GLB with good density — voxel+decimate produces usable topology automatically.
steps.max_scenario: Dense or noisy mesh requires manual retopology after the automated pass.

steps.name: TransferUVsToLo
steps.label: Transfer UVs to Proxy
steps.goal: Transfer UV maps from the design GLB (source) onto the proxy mesh (target) so the Meshy textures work on the clean topology.
steps.pass_criteria: Proxy mesh has a UVMap layer with transferred data.
steps.fail_criteria: Source or target mesh not found, or DATA_TRANSFER failed.
steps.min_scenario: Clean proxy close to source density — nearest-face projection transfers cleanly.
steps.max_scenario: Topology too different; manual UV unwrap required after the automated pass.

steps.name: PlaceGeometry
steps.label: Place Geometry
steps.goal: Scale the proxy mesh to the asset's canonical height and ground it at Z=0. Runs after UV transfer so the transfer operates on co-located meshes (fast BVH lookup).
steps.pass_criteria: Proxy mesh is grounded and scaled to the correct height.
steps.fail_criteria: Proxy mesh not found in scene.

steps.name: EnsureModelGroup
steps.label: Ensure Model Group
steps.goal: Guarantee the canonical model grouping: mdl/hi collection with the proxy geometry inside. DSN collection is hidden.
steps.pass_criteria: The mdl/hi collection exists with the proxy mesh inside.
steps.fail_criteria: The grouping could not be created.

steps.name: SetRenderSettings
steps.label: Set Render Settings
steps.goal: Set the clay 'playblast' render look (same language as previs) and make sure a turntable exists to render.
steps.pass_criteria: Clay render settings applied; turntable ready.

steps.name: Playblast
steps.label: Playblast
steps.goal: Render the turntable camera over its frame range to the version render dir (the clay 'playblast' of the model).
steps.pass_criteria: Frames rendered to the render dir.

steps.name: ProcessRenders
steps.label: Process Renders
steps.goal: Encode the rendered frame sequence into a review mp4 at the version preview path.

steps.name: CleanTt
steps.label: Clean Turntable
steps.goal:
Remove any turntable rig before publishing (reparents the model back
to world). Delegates to the Blender common etymology op.
steps.min_scenario: You do the cleanup by hand before handing off — quick when you remember it.
steps.max_scenario: You forget or do it wrong; the mistake ships in the file and gets flagged downstream, forcing a redo.

steps.name: PivotsToOrigin
steps.label: Pivots To Origin
steps.goal:
Place the model's transform handle (the mdl Empty) at the world origin
for consistent placement. Self-healing: ensures the mdl group exists and
collects loose geometry into it first.
steps.min_scenario: You do the cleanup by hand before handing off — quick when you remember it.
steps.max_scenario: You forget or do it wrong; the mistake ships in the file and gets flagged downstream, forcing a redo.

steps.name: DeleteHistory
steps.label: Delete History
steps.goal:
Bake construction history (apply the modifier stack) on the model before
export. Near no-op for a clean mdl. Delegates to common.edit.delete_history.
steps.min_scenario: You do the cleanup by hand before handing off — quick when you remember it.
steps.max_scenario: You forget or do it wrong; the mistake ships in the file and gets flagged downstream, forcing a redo.

steps.name: FreezeTransformations
steps.label: Freeze Transformations
steps.goal:
Freeze the model handle's transform (bake loc/rot/scale to identity)
before export. Delegates to mdl.edit.freeze_transforms.
steps.min_scenario: You do the cleanup by hand before handing off — quick when you remember it.
steps.max_scenario: You forget or do it wrong; the mistake ships in the file and gets flagged downstream, forcing a redo.

steps.name: EnsureMaterialGroups
steps.label: Ensure Material Groups
steps.goal: Guarantee the {material}_mtl grouping convention: if a model has no material groups (a Meshy/un-Shader-Buddied mesh), wrap its geometry into a single default_mtl group + basic clay 'default' material so Substance/lighting/MSD treat it like a hand-modeled asset. Idempotent.
steps.min_scenario: A Meshy model carries a clean default_mtl/clay placeholder and flows through the rest of the pipeline unchanged.
steps.max_scenario: A groupless model breaks Substance texture-set boundaries and the lighting attach downstream.

steps.name: SaveScene
steps.label: Save Scene
steps.goal:
Save the working .blend (pivots applied) before the export-only
cleanup. Delegates to the common etymology save op.
steps.min_scenario: You do the cleanup by hand before handing off — quick when you remember it.
steps.max_scenario: You forget or do it wrong; the mistake ships in the file and gets flagged downstream, forcing a redo.

steps.name: ExportModelFileFormats
steps.label: Export Model File Formats
steps.goal:
Export the mdl group to the version's render dir in every pipeline format
(.blend whole-file + .fbx/.obj/.usd/.glb of the group). Selects the group
via mdl.query.members.
steps.min_scenario: You hand-export the file(s) to the right place in the right format(s), double-checking the path — when you remember every format and where it goes.
steps.max_scenario: A format's missing, the path's wrong, or settings are off; downstream can't find or use it, pings you, and you re-export — days of back-and-forth.

steps.name: ExportScaledDesignModel
steps.label: Export Scaled Design Model
steps.goal:
Export the design geometry at PRODUCTION SCALE as a model artifact
({model_stem}_dsn.glb), so consumers stop re-deriving the scale at import.
steps.pass_criteria: the scaled design mesh is in the render dir, or the asset genuinely has no design mesh and is named
steps.fail_criteria: the design mesh is in the scene but was not written.
steps.min_scenario: You hand-scale the hero mesh to the declared height, ground it and export it, once, correctly.
steps.max_scenario: Every consumer re-derives the size itself, each one differently; a corrected height reaches the model but not the high-res mesh, and nobody can tell an intended scale from a bug.

steps.name: GenerateSceneDescription
steps.label: Generate Scene Description
steps.goal:
Capture the model scene description (geometry/materials/assignments) and
persist it onto the version MSD's data payload so it survives publish and
feeds the ldv build. Delegates to mdl.query.get_msd_data.
steps.min_scenario: Someone hand-enters the notes/metadata for the records — quick when they bother.
steps.max_scenario: It's left blank; downstream has no context for what changed and has to ask around or guess.

steps.name: AddDescription
steps.label: Add Description
steps.goal:
Ensure a publish description is set. Headless/farm-safe: comes from
shared_data (set by the trigger/UI), with a sensible default — no dialog.
steps.min_scenario: Someone hand-enters the notes/metadata for the records — quick when they bother.
steps.max_scenario: It's left blank; downstream has no context for what changed and has to ask around or guess.

steps.name: Publish
steps.label: Publish
steps.goal:
Publish the cleaned version: copy the user version to the next major +
the publish/latest location, and mirror the publish to the tracker (a SG
Version). Delegates to PathObject.publish().
steps.min_scenario: You manually copy the version to the publish/latest location and a coordinator hand-updates the tracker and pings downstream — when everyone actually does their part.
steps.max_scenario: The coordinator's slammed and forgets (or no one notifies downstream); everyone waiting burns days on Slack, text, email, phone, and walking the building to find out if it's ready.

steps.name: MeasureHeight
steps.label: Measure Height
steps.goal: Create a Measurement for the current selected object.  Look at the bounding box create a visual representation showing the starting point and ending point that you're measuring from and text on screen with the height in imperical and cm.

steps.name: ShaderBuddy
steps.label: ShaderBuddy
steps.goal: Open ShaderBuddy: ensure every mesh in the model group (mdl/high) carries one object-level material from the shared BRDF library, so Substance reads a clean texture set per material.

stash its printf pattern + frame range in shared_data for downstream steps.

steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.
